g.text: All retained terms refitted to development PFS, ridge .01. Same candidate and fold representations; no candidate reselection.
Binary: Altman–Bland. Continuous: treatment × raw log HR(z), adjusted for main effects. Internal Cox evaluation stratifies by fold.
Terms are coefficient counts, not effective degrees of freedom. Nominal robust inference conditions on predictions; no between-model superiority test.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a33122
